75210-with-the-empress-dowager-of-china.creator: Unknown
75210-with-the-empress-dowager-of-china.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. 50 CONTINUATION OF THE PORTRAIT Advantages and Disadvantages of Painting in the Throne-room-- The Empress Dowager’s Voice--Chinese Opinion as to Portraits of Royalty--Walks with Her Majesty--Her Dogs--Their Pavilions--Cats--The Empress Dowager’s Gift of “Me-lah.” CHAPTER VII.

arxiv-1806-03510.title: Feature Pyramid Network for Multi-Class Land Segmentation
arxiv-1806-03510.creator: Selim S. Seferbekov, Vladimir I. Iglovikov, Alexander V. Buslaev, Alexey A. Shvets
arxiv-1806-03510.description: Abstract Semantic segmentation is in-demand in satellite imagery processing. Because of the complex environment, automatic categorization and segmentation of land cover is a challenging problem. Solving it can help to overcome many obstacles in urban planning, environmental engineering or natural landscape monitoring.

arxiv-2006-06350.title: Wilks’ theorem for semiparametric regressions with weakly dependent data
arxiv-2006-06350.creator: Marie Du Roy de Chaumarayabel=e1, mark]marie.du-roy-de-chaumaray@ensai.fr, Matthieu Marbacabel=e2, mark]matthieu.marbac-lourdelle@ensai.fr, Valentin Patileaabel=e3, mark]valentin.patilea@ensai.fr
arxiv-2006-06350.description: Abstract The empirical likelihood inference is extended to a class of semiparametric models for stationary, weakly dependent series. A partially linear single-index regression is used for the conditional mean of the series given its past, and the present and past values of a vector of covariates.

arxiv-2104-08636.title: Avoiding the bullies: The resilience of cooperation among unequals
arxiv-2104-08636.creator: Michael Foley, Rory Smead, Patrick Forber, Christoph Riedl
arxiv-2104-08636.description: Abstract Can egalitarian norms or conventions survive the presence of dominant individuals who are ensured of victory in conflicts? We investigate the interaction of power asymmetry and partner choice in games of conflict over a contested resource. Previous models of cooperation do not include both power inequality and partner choice.

arxiv-2211-14108.title: 3DDesigner: Towards Photorealistic 3D Object Generation and Editing with Text-guided Diffusion Models
arxiv-2211-14108.creator: Gang Li 1,2, Heliang Zheng 3, Chaoyue Wang 3, Chang Li 3, Changwen Zheng 1, Dacheng Tao 3
arxiv-2211-14108.description: Abstract Text-guided diffusion models have shown superior performance in image/video generation and editing. While few explorations have been performed in 3D scenarios. In this paper, we discuss three fundamental and interesting problems on this topic. First, we equip text-guided diffusion models to achieve 3D-consistent generation .

arxiv-2303-04101.title: Exchange Rate Pass-Through and Data Frequency: Firm-Level Evidence from Bangladesh I am grateful to Dr. Georg Schaur for all his feedback on this study.
arxiv-2303-04101.creator: Md Deluair Hossen
arxiv-2303-04101.description: Abstract The vast literature on exchange rate fluctuations estimates the exchange rate pass-through (ERPT). Most ERPT studies consider annually aggregated data for developed or large developing countries for estimating ERPT. These estimates vary widely depending on the type of country, data coverage, and frequency. However, the ERPT estimation using firm-level high-frequency export data of a small developing country is rare.

arxiv-2402-02545.title: Classification of tennis actions using deep learning
arxiv-2402-02545.creator: 1. Emil Hovad, 2. Therese Hougaard-Jensen, 3. Line Katrine Harder Clemmensen
arxiv-2402-02545.description: Abstract Recent advances of deep learning makes it possible to identify specific events in videos with greater precision. This has great relevance in sports like tennis in order to e.g., automatically collect game statistics, or replay actions of specific interest for game strategy or player improvements.

arxiv-2404-16810.creator: Giorgos Kotsovolis
arxiv-2404-16810.description: Abstract . We give a complete list of the points in the spectrum 𝒵 = { inf ( x , y ) ∈ Λ , x ​ y ≠ 0 | x ​ y | , Λ is a unimodular rational lattice of ℝ 2 } \mathcal{Z}=\{\inf_{(x,y)\in\Lambda,xy\neq 0}{\left|xy\right|},\,\text{$\Lambda$ is a unimodular rational lattice of $\mathbb{R}^{2}$}\} above 1 3 . \frac{1}{3}.

arxiv-2405-16868.title: RCDN: Towards Robust Camera-Insensitivity Collaborative Perception via Dynamic Feature-based 3D Neural Modeling
arxiv-2405-16868.creator: Tianhang Wang, Fan Lu, Zehan Zheng, Zhijun Li, Guang Chen, Changjun Jiang
arxiv-2405-16868.description: Abstract Collaborative perception is dedicated to tackling the constraints of single-agent perception, such as occlusions, based on the multiple agents’ multi-view sensor inputs. However, most existing works assume an ideal condition that all agents’ multi-view cameras are continuously available. In reality, cameras may be highly noisy, obscured or even failed during the collaboration.

arxiv-2407-01246.title: First Ion Temperature Measurements in the MAST-U Divertor via Retarding Field Energy Analyzer
arxiv-2407-01246.creator: Y. Damizia, S. Elmore, P. Ryan, S. Allan, F.Federici, N.Osborne, J. W. Bradley, the MAST-U Team
arxiv-2407-01246.description: Abstract This study presents the first ion temperature ( T i T_{i} ) measurements from the MAST-U divertor using a Retarding Field Energy Analyzer (RFEA). Embedded within the flat tile of the closed divertor chamber, the RFEA captures T i T_{i} profiles across various plasma scenarios, including transitions to the Super-X configuration.

arxiv-2411-17947.title: Dark Matter Axion Detection with Neural Networks at Ultra-Low Signal-to-Noise Ratio
arxiv-2411-17947.creator: José Reina-Valero a, Alejandro Díaz-Morcillo b, José Gadea-Rodríguez b, Benito Gimeno a, Antonio José Lozano-Guerrero b, Juan Monzó-Cabrera b, Jose R. Navarro-Madrid b, Juan Luis Pedreño-Molina b
arxiv-2411-17947.description: Abstract We present the first analysis of Dark Matter axion detection applying neural networks for the improvement of sensitivity. The main sources of thermal noise from a typical read-out chain are simulated, constituted by resonant and amplifier noises. With this purpose, an advanced modal method employed in electromagnetic modal analysis for the design of complex microwave circuits is applied.

arxiv-2501-00853.title: a dual representation theorem on the conditional Orlicz space generated from a random normed module Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author.
arxiv-2501-00853.creator: Xia Zhang, Ke Qian, Ming Liu ∗
arxiv-2501-00853.description: Abstract . In this paper, we first introduce the notion of a random Orlicz function, and further present the conditional Orlicz space generated from a random normed module. Second, we prove the denseness of the Orlicz heart of a random normed module E E in E E with respect to the ( ε , λ ) (\varepsilon,\lambda) -topology.

arxiv-2506-05747.title: Asymmetric Perturbation in Solving Bilinear Saddle-Point Optimization
arxiv-2506-05747.creator: Kenshi Abe, Mitsuki Sakamoto, Kaito Ariu, Atsushi Iwasaki
arxiv-2506-05747.description: Abstract This paper proposes an asymmetric perturbation technique for solving saddle-point optimization problems, commonly arising in min-max problems, game theory, and constrained optimization. Perturbing payoffs or values are known to be effective in stabilizing learning dynamics and finding an exact solution or equilibrium. However, it requires careful adjustment of the perturbation magnitude; otherwise, learning dynamics converge to only an equilibrium.

arxiv-2602-22435.title: Computing Invariants of Artin-Schreier Curves
arxiv-2602-22435.creator: Juanita Duque-Rosero, Elisa Lorenzo García, Beth Malmskog, Renate Scheidler
arxiv-2602-22435.description: Abstract . We present an algorithmic framework for computing generators for the ring of invariants of an Artin-Schreier curve. We give explicit invariants for almost all Artin-Schreier curves of genus up to 8 in standard form, and for a handful of curves of higher genus. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 11G20, 14L24, 13A50, 14G15, 14H10, 14H45, 14Q05 1.

pmc-10610335.title: Radiometals in Imaging and Therapy: Highlighting Two Decades of Research
pmc-10610335.creator: Shalini Sharma, Mukesh K Pandey, Irina Velikyan, Klaus Kopka
pmc-10610335.description: The present article highlights the important progress made in the last two decades in the fields of molecular imaging and radionuclide therapy. Advancements in radiometal-based positron emission tomography, single photon emission computerized tomography, and radionuclide therapy are illustrated in terms of their production routes and ease of radiolabeling.

pmc-11358935.title: Preclinical Safety Assessment of the EBS-LASV Vaccine Candidate against Lassa Fever Virus
pmc-11358935.creator: Demetrius Matassov, Lisa Evans DeWald, Stefan Hamm, Rebecca M. Nowak, Cheryl S. Gerardi, Theresa E. Latham, Rong Xu, Amara Luckay, Tracy Chen, Marc Tremblay, Jeffry Shearer, Melissa Wynn, John H. Eldridge, Kelly Warfield, Kevin Spurgers
pmc-11358935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). There are currently no prophylactic vaccines licensed to protect against Lassa fever caused by Lassa virus (LASV) infection. The Emergent BioSolutions (EBS) vaccine candidate, EBS-LASV, is being developed for the prevention of Lassa fever. EBS-LASV is a live-attenuated recombinant Vesicular Stomatitis Virus (rVSV)-vectored vaccine encoding the surface glycoprotein complex (GPC) from LASV and has two attenuating vector modifications: a gene shuffle of the VSV N gene and a deletion of the VSV G gene.

pmc-11519615.title: Programmable and flexible wood-based origami electronics
pmc-11519615.creator: Huashuo Ma, Chaozheng Liu, Zhi Yang, Shuai Wu, Yue Jiao, Xinhao Feng, Bo Xu, Rongxian Ou, Changtong Mei, Zhaoyang Xu, Jianxiong Lyu, Yanjun Xie, Qiliang Fu
pmc-11519615.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Natural polymer substrates are gaining attention as substitutes for plastic substrates in electronics, aiming to combine high performance, intricate shape deformation, and environmental sustainability. Herein, natural wood veneer is converted into a transparent wood film (TWF) substrate. The combination of 3D printing and origami technique is established to create programmable wood-based origami electronics, which exhibit superior flexibility with high tensile strength (393 MPa) due to the highly aligned cellulose fibers and the formation of numerous intermolecular hydrogen bonds between them.

pmc-11691405.title: COGNITIVE REAPPRAISAL AND STRESS REACTIVITY ACROSS ADULTHOOD
pmc-11691405.creator: Jessica Maras, Kate Leger
pmc-11691405.description: How one reacts to stressful events, termed stress reactivity, impacts health and well-being. The use of emotion regulation strategies can influence reactivity, specifically cognitive reappraisal, which has been shown to reduce reactivity. Furthermore, age can affect reactivity due to older adults’ ability to employ cognitive reappraisal strategies more readily.

pmc-12495772.title: Association between short-term exposure to ambient ozone concentration and influenza incidence in Kawasaki City, Japan: a time-stratified case-crossover analysis
pmc-12495772.creator: Keita Wagatsuma
pmc-12495772.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundSeasonal influenza continues to pose a significant global public health challenge owing to its considerable disease burden, making it imperative to elucidate its potential driving factors. Although the roles of meteorological factors such as temperature and absolute humidity have been extensively investigated, research quantifying the burden of ambient ozone (O₃) as an environmental determinant of influenza, particularly among vulnerable populations, remains limited.

pmc-12674818.title: The impact of a multicomponent telemedicine-based intervention on quality of life in adults with respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation: protocol for a cluster stepped-wedge randomized clinical trial (Tele-Rehab MV Trial)
pmc-12674818.creator: Adriano José Pereira, Rafael Barberena Moraes, Geraldine Trott, Maura Cristina dos Santos, Duane Mocellin, Alessandra Yuri Takehana de Andrade, Aline Paula Miozzo, Luisa de Castro Miranda Paixão, Raíne Fogliati de Carli Schardosin, Carla Luciana Batista, Emelyn de Souza Roldão, Cilene Saghabi de Med
pmc-12674818.description: ObjectiveTo assess the impact of a multicomponent intervention on the health-related quality of life of patients with hypoxemic respiratory failure requiring invasive mechanical ventilation.MethodsA cluster stepped-wedge randomized clinical trial will be conducted in intensive care units across Brazil. Intensive care units with ≥ 8 beds and the capacity to admit patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure will be included.

pmc-12730237.title: The Impact of Neurotoxin Proteins Trafficked by Primary Cilia and Extracellular Vesicles in Neurodegenerative Diseases
pmc-12730237.creator: Riley Danna, Soham Kondle, Orr Amar, Michayla Mabourakh, Gratiana Chen, Wala B Fadol, Ashraf M Mohieldin, Xinhua Shu, Luis Gandía
pmc-12730237.description: Simple SummaryThis review explores the role of primary cilia and extracellular vesicles in neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and Huntington’s diseases. We discuss how ciliogenesis can disrupt important signaling pathways, as well as its involvement in the aggregation of neurotoxic proteins and the trafficking and clearance of these proteins.

pmc-12960995.title: A 3D modeling framework for accurate trajectory-based prediction of critical diameter in deterministic lateral displacement microfluidics
pmc-12960995.creator: Jin Chen, Xiwei Huang, Weipeng Xuan, Lingling Sun
pmc-12960995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Deterministic Lateral Displacement (DLD) is a high-precision microfluidic technique for particle separation based on size differences. However, the lack of an accurate predictive model for the critical diameter (Dc) limits both the design flexibility and understanding of DLD behavior. In this study, we propose a novel Dc prediction framework based on a 3D physical model, achieving high accuracy and computational efficiency. Experimental validation shows excellent agreement between predicted and actual particle trajectories.

pmc-13235452.title: Phase 1 study of zanubrutinib plus lenalidomide for patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
pmc-13235452.creator: Zheng Song, Ying Cheng, Haiyan Yang, Liling Zhang, Liqun Zou, Ye Guo, Junning Cao, Huiqiang Huang, Zhao Wang, Sha Huang, Yiqian Fang, Jiaoyan Lyu, Yiting Zhang, Yang Liu, Keshu Zhou, Huilai Zhang
pmc-13235452.description: Key Points•Zanubrutinib plus lenalidomide combination therapy demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity with durable responses across DLBCL subtypes.•This all-oral combination has a favorable risk-benefit profile and may be a potential option for patients ineligible for other therapies. Introduction Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common form of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, comprising 30% to 50% of all cases globally.

pmc-13283611.title: Longitudinal Changes in Functional Reaction Time in Adolescent Athletes Post-Concussion
pmc-13283611.creator: Shannon Nagle, William Meehan, Rebekah Mannix, Jessie Oldham, Landon Lempke
pmc-13283611.description: Background:Reaction time is a common clinical measure for assessing patients with concussion, but common approaches have limited functional applicability (i.e., sport-related with cognitive-motor integration). Previous studies have recently developed a reliable and valid functional reaction time battery called the Standardized Assessment of Reaction Time (StART) to assess functional reaction time.

pmc-13331060.title: Mitigating future pandemics: the need for socio-behavioural data collection systems and proactive community engagement
pmc-13331060.creator: Keenan Duggal, Nina Gobat, Thomas Moran, Thomas Abraham, Daniel Romer, Jim Duggan, Vicky Houssiere, Olivia Tulloch, Wenqing Zhang, Jean-Michel Heraud, Kai Von Harbou
pmc-13331060.description: rapid transmission of respiratory pathogens. Consequently, the frequency of global pandemics has accelerated in recent decades. The COVID-19 pandemic and recent isolated cases of H5N1 influenza (bird influenza) detected in pigs, cows and humans underscore the dynamic, often unpredictable nature of pathogens, and serve as reminders that we must remain alert to the risk of future pandemics.

pmc-13430794.title: Household food insecurity status in Gulina District, zone 4 of conflict affected Afar Regional State, Northeast Ethiopia
pmc-13430794.creator: Fiseha Tsegaye, Goitom Sisay
pmc-13430794.description: Investigating the Household Food insecurity situation of conflict affected communities has increasingly become a widespread issue around the world. Gulina District, situated within Zone 4 of the Afar region, faced significant challenges related to the impacts of conflict, which severely affect household food security. The study aimed to assess the household food security status in the conflict-affected Gulina District.

pmc-13504141.title: A prognostic model for breast cancer based on mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) signature genes
pmc-13504141.creator: Jintao Cui, Limin Wei, Bin Xu, Songfu Han, Chaoyanng Guo, Xinshuai Wang

pmc-13572610.title: Effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on working conditions and mental health among employees in health and social services
pmc-13572610.creator: Claudia Peters, Madeleine Dulon, Jan Felix Kersten, Christofer Hartung, Albert Nienhaus, Anja Schablon
pmc-13572610.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has posed major challenges in the workplace. This exploratory, cross-sectional study investigated the association between occupational activities and mental health.MethodsIn 2023, 576 employees from health and social care institutions were surveyed about their occupational situation, their self-assessed ability to work, health-related issues, as well as their mental health and quality of life.

pmc-13573486.creator: Andrea Marti, Alexander Nater, Jenny Pego Magalhaes, Noelle Donzé, Markus Gerber, Lea Almeida, Matthias Liniger, Sandra Chenaux, Nicolas Ruggli, Fadi G. Alnaji, Marco Vignuzzi, Obdulio Garcia-Nicolas, Artur Summerfield
